name: ນາງຈຳປາ · ດາບດອກໄມ້

prompt: Native Lao, natural Vientiane pronunciation. Female youthful anime heroine, bright medium-high pitch, clear and warm, a smile and brave resolve. Start gently, take a brief dramatic pause, then deliver the final phrase with confident protective energy. Natural speech, not singing. Clean studio recording; speech only.

name: ເທວີດາບຈຳປາທອງ · ປົກກະຕິ

name: ເທວີດາບຈຳປາທອງ · ອາດພິເສດແປງຮ່າງ

line: ແສງຈຳປາ… ຈົ່ງເບັ່ງບານ!
